The cat is shown kicking and biting the toy playfully on a black circular rug. (2) A transition occurs showing a person's hand holding a long, cylindrical yellow and white plush toy designed to look like a cartoon cat wearing a small black and red hat. (4) The final shot shows the yellow catnip toy resting alone on the floor, with various brand information and social media handles appearing as overlays.
